letterContent: They say extending an olive branch is a silent promise to protect each other's peace.
I am holding this branch out to you with both hands. I cherish what we share far too much to let anger stay between us.
Let’s let bygones be bygones and nurture our bond back to full bloom.

scratchCard.title: ✦ OLIVE BRANCH PLEDGE ✦
scratchCard.hiddenText: Truce Gift: 1x Home-Cooked Dinner + Full Evening Foot Massage 🍵

runawayQuestion.question: Will you take the olive branch?
runawayQuestion.successMessage: You took it! Our peace is restored! 🌿❤
